record.dic_text:
05711 `Adah {aw-daw'}

源自 05710; 陰性專有名詞

欽定本 - Adah 8; 8

亞大 = "裝飾"
1) 拉麥兩個妻子中的大老婆, 雅八和猶八的母親
2) 赫人, 以掃的三個妻子之一, 以利法的母親
record.edic_text:
05711 `Adah {aw-daw'}

from 05710;; n pr f

AV - Adah 8; 8

Adah = "ornament"
1) the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal
2) a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz
   2a) also called 'Bashemath'
